lane: مَلَابٌ a Persian word, (TA,) A kind of perfume, (S, K,) like خَلُوق (S): or saffron. (IAar, K.) === مَلَابَةٌ A fascicle, or small bundle, of filaments of saffron; a shive of saffron. (IAar). مَلَابٌ : see art. لوب, in which, as well as here, it is mentioned in the K.

entries.text: الملاب، كسحاب: عطر، أو الزعفران، وذكر في: ل وب.
